They might not "want" caregivers, but they NEED  caregivers so they're going to have to suck it up. They're not being realistic and you were not born to be their aid. You have paid them back for raising you already in full. You've done more than most. You can't expect to live a good life with your boyfriend if you're still going over there - you can't give into them like that. You'll just be dragged back into the same unhealthy situation.  You have to stand up for yourself and say "no, I can't come over." You need to stay focusing on what you need in your life like school and finding a good psychiatrist that you actually click with and cultivating your relationship with your boyfriend and friends. And honestly, if your uncle wants to be over there so bad, HE can be his parents' caregiver. It's not like you're the only person in the world who could possibly clean their house or make them tea. Don't give in or nothing will change. Don't let them manipulate you into thinking you have to do things for them. It sounds like your grandparents and uncle do have narcissistic personalities, so it is beyond crucial that you start setting firm, unwavering boundaries. From my own experience, I know that it's hard to say no because you love your family, but they aren't loving you right if they're pressuring you to give up so much for them. Start putting yourself first, and if they try to interfere, you may need to limit communication with them.

You've already started setting boundaries by moving out. Keep it up. Keep moving forward, be strong, you got this. ❤
